data.title: 埃塔 · 战服数据测量日
data.description: 埃塔穿着自己的史莱姆战服站在测量台上，对着镜子将软尺绕在腰间，旁边的记录板上写着设计尺寸。百褶裙式的战服是她亲手改的，数据可不能记错。
data.location: laboratory fitting platform with measuring tapes, mirrors and data crystals
data.action: standing alone on a fitting platform in her pleated slime outfit, measuring her waist with a tape before a mirror
data.lighting: 测量室均匀的白色灯光
data.promptProse: Eta stands alone on the fitting platform in her pleated slime outfit, checking a measuring tape around her waist in the mirror.
data.animaCaption: Eta checks the tape against the notes on her clipboard.
